# ARL

> ARL is the native utility token planned for decentralized AI and compute services, an ERC-20
> on Base. It is live on the Base Sepolia testnet only (testnet tokens have no value); no ARL
> contract exists on Base Mainnet, nothing is for sale, and nothing on arlcoin.io is an offer,
> investment advice or a promise of listing.

Key facts:

- Maximum supply: 21,000,000 ARL, minted once at deployment into 11 allocations. The token
  contract has no owner, no mint function after deployment, no pause and no upgrade path.
- Standard: ERC-20 with EIP-2612 permit, 18 decimals, on Base (Ethereum layer 2).
- Testnet: Base Sepolia (chain 84532), token 0x244312b619127B6458154F3467eFD7c87CD28500,
  source-verified on Basescan, Blockscout and Sourcify.
- Mainnet: Base (chain 8453), targeted for 1 November 2026. The address will be published on
  arlcoin.io at deployment; any earlier "ARL" on a main network is not official.
- How a payment works: the wallet signs a spending ceiling (x402 upto scheme, Permit2), the AI
  or compute service meters the work, a facilitator settles only the ARL used, never above the
  ceiling, and the transfer is recorded on Base where anyone can verify it; ratings are kept on
  the ERC-8004 registry.
- Planned uses: AI services paid per use in ARL, GPU and CPU compute paid per second,
  zero-knowledge anonymous signals, and staking funded from existing allocations, never from
  new issuance.
- Security: internal review complete (unit, fuzz and invariant tests, static analysis,
  symbolic checks). No external audit has been performed. Treasury actions pass a Safe
  multisig and a 48-hour timelock.
- Roadmap: foundation and token contracts complete, internal security review complete, Base
  Sepolia testnet live since 4 October 2026, Base Mainnet targeted for 1 November 2026.
- ARL never asks for a private key, a seed phrase or a payment.
